description: Defines interfaces and classes for managing task executors in the CU-UP component of a 3GPP-related system, including executor mappers for UEs and CU-UP, and configuration structures for strand-based executor setup.

classes.name: ue_executor_mapper
classes.description: Interface for accessing executors related to a specific UE in the CU-UP.

classes.name: cu_up_executor_mapper
classes.description: Interface for accessing various executors used in the CU-UP, including common, IO, and data read executors.

classes.name: strand_based_executor_config
classes.description: Configuration structure for setting up strand-based executor pools in CU-UP.

methods.name: make_cu_up_executor_mapper
methods.description: Factory function to create a CU-UP executor mapper based on strand configuration.
